# Precision Quality Services - Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
> https://limsreportgenerator.vercel.app

## Overview
Precision Quality Services (PQS) LIMS is an enterprise laboratory management platform engineered for environmental, wastewater, metallurgical, and chemical testing laboratories. It adheres to ISO/IEC 17025 standards for electronic record integrity, tamper-proof audit trails, and cryptographic verification.

## Core Capabilities
- **Standard-Compliant Laboratory Reports:** 7-column analytical test reports (`TEST`, `TEST METHOD`, `VALUE`, `UNIT`, `CRITERIA`, `UNIT`, `RESULT`) with dynamic regulatory criteria matching (PEQS, WHO, ASTM, APHA).
- **Invoicing & Commercial Quotations:** Laboratory testing service invoices with automated total calculations, NTN numbers, and line-item summaries.
- **Official Letterheads:** Pre-formatted ISO 9001/17025 accredited laboratory documentation with verified certification marks.
- **Cryptographic Document Seals:** Client-side SHA-256 hash generation for every issued report (`PQS-XXXXXXXXXXXX`) encoded into QR verification codes.
- **Public Document Verification:** Real-time online document verification portal (`/verify/receipt?id=...&seal=...`) allowing third-party purchasers and regulators to inspect authenticity.

## Architecture & Technology
- Framework: Next.js 16 (Turbopack, Static Export)
- Desktop Runtime: Tauri v2 + Rust
- Offline Resilience: Supabase Cloud Sync with local browser persistence
- Typography: Inter, Montserrat, Good Times Bold
